schema_version_doc: Unit: schema token. Allowed: robot_v4_deployment_manifest_v1. Default: none; native bindings reject missing or different values. Prevents loading a cell manifest that the native reader cannot interpret.
name: simulation-cell
name_doc: Unverified example. Unit: display text. Allowed: a JSON string; ignored by native compatibility validation. Default: omitted in native validation. Prevents confusing cell inventory entries.

nodes.runtime_doc: Unverified example. Unit: runtime token. Allowed: rt-core for a native node; this envelope hint is ignored by the native binding validator, which selects rt_core blocks. Default: omitted in native validation; use the selected deployment runtime in cell configs. Prevents mislabeling the process that consumes a native binding.

rt_core.machine_config_doc: Unverified example. Unit: repository-relative path. Allowed: an existing config/machines JSON with no traversal or escaping symlink. Default: required. Prevents compiling an unrelated machine.
rt_core.configuration_sha256_doc: Unverified example. Unit: 64 lowercase hex digits. Allowed: the exact rtctl compile digest. Default: optional in the reader; pin every deployed cell. Prevents stale machine admission.
rt_core.pair_id_doc: Unverified example. Unit: identity token. Allowed: nonempty letters, digits, underscore, dot or hyphen. Default: required. Prevents binding another machine pair.
rt_core.pair_revision_doc: Unverified example. Unit: generation number. Allowed: positive uint64. Default: required. Prevents reuse of obsolete deployment authority.
rt_core.remote_listen_doc: Unverified example. Unit: host:port. Allowed: IP or valid DNS host and port 1..65535. Default: required. Prevents ambiguous endpoint binding.

nodes.rt_core_doc: Unverified example. Unit: JSON object. Allowed: the annotated fields below, with mutually exclusive branches selected before compilation. Default: required by its containing branch. Prevents silently inventing rt core settings.

nodes_doc: Unverified example. Unit: ordered JSON array. Allowed: ordered entries matching the annotated element class. Default: required. Prevents missing or reordered nodes from silently changing configuration.
